Currency Act 1967
Currency
(Denominations and Characteristics of Coins)
(No. 2) Notification 2023
Pursuant to section 17(5) of the Currency Act 1967, it is notified for general information that the denominations and characteristics of the coins to be issued on 1 January 2024 by the Monetary Authority of Singapore are as shown in the Schedule.

THE SCHEDULE
DESCRIPTION OF THE 2024 CHINESE ALMANAC COINS
(YEAR OF THE DRAGON) TO BE ISSUED ON 1 JANUARY 2024
PART 1
Denomination
$2
Metal
999 Fine Silver
Nickel-plated 99% Zinc
Standard Weight
7.776 g + 0.15 g
20.000 g + 1.70 g
Standard Diameter
27.00 mm ± 0.30 mm
40.70 mm ± 0.40 mm
Standard Thickness
1.90 mm ± 0.40 mm
2.90 mm ± 0.40 mm
Shape
Round
Edge
Milled
Design of Obverse
1.The background of the $2 silver proof‑like colour coin and the $2 nickel‑plated zinc proof‑like coin is shiny silver.
2.The Singapore Coat of Arms is engraved in the centre of the coin with the year‑date “2024” below it.
3.The word “SINGAPORE” appears once in each of the 4 official languages and is engraved on the coin around the Singapore Coat of Arms.
Design of Reverse
1.The background of the $2 silver proof‑like colour coin and the $2 nickel-plated zinc proof‑like coin is shiny silver.
2.The $2 silver proof‑like colour coin and the $2 nickel‑plated zinc proof‑like coin share a common design which features —
(a)a dragon in the centre of the foreground against the background of Gardens by the Bay;
(b)2 Supertrees in the background, one on each of the left and right sides of the coin, and both partially covered by the dragon’s head and body;
(c)the Flower Dome in the background on the right side of the coin, partially covered by the dragon’s head; and
(d)the denomination “$2” engraved and placed at 12 o’clock, above the dragon.
3.The weight in troy oz and fineness of the coin are engraved above the dragon of the $2 silver proof‑like colour coin.
4.The dragon featured in the $2 silver proof‑like colour coin is in colour.

Design of Obverse
1.The background of the $5 silver proof coin and the $5 silver proof colour coin is shiny silver.
2.The background of the $5 gold brilliant uncirculated coin is shiny gold.
3.The Singapore Coat of Arms is engraved in the centre of the coin with the year‑date “2024” below it.
4.The word “SINGAPORE” appears once in each of the 4 official languages and is engraved on the coin around the Singapore Coat of Arms.
5.The mintmark is engraved on the coin around the Singapore Coat of Arms at 5 o’clock for the $5 silver proof coin and the $5 silver proof colour coin.
Design of Reverse
1.The background of the $5 silver proof coin and the $5 silver proof colour coin is shiny silver.
2.The background of the $5 gold brilliant uncirculated coin is shiny gold.
3.The $5 silver proof coin and the $5 silver proof colour coin share a common design which features —
(a)a dragon in the centre of the foreground against the background of Gardens by the Bay;
(b)2 Supertrees in the background, one on each of the left and right sides of the coin, and both partially covered by the dragon’s head and body;
(c)the Flower Dome in the background on the right side of the coin, partially covered by the dragon’s head;
(d)the denomination “$5” engraved and placed at 12 o’clock, above the dragon; and
(e)the weight in troy oz and fineness of the coin, engraved above the dragon.
4.The dragon featured in the $5 silver proof colour coin is in colour.
5.The $5 gold brilliant uncirculated coin features —
(a)a dragon engraved in the centre;
(b)the denomination “$5” engraved and placed at 6 o’clock, below the dragon; and
(c)the weight in grams and fineness of the coin, engraved above the dragon.
